fusions.name: Nose and Echo
fusions.desc: Sends a click and a whiff of musk into the first enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 4 seconds. It then echoes on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of the damage.

fusions.name: Nightfall Flyby
fusions.desc: Swoops to an enemy up to 6 tiles away and sprays as you pass, dealing 12 damage to everything in a cone 3 tiles long and leaving it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Roost Mate
fusions.desc: Looses a roost-mate for 10 seconds that swoops on an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, each pass with a 30% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Dusk Riser
fusions.desc: At night, you deal 12% more damage.
